name: accumarray_fn
comment: Sig: accumarray(subs,vals,sz,@fn[,fillval]). 2026-06-04: arbitrary function handles (named or anonymous), not just the built-in reducers (@sum/@max/...), are applied to each output cell's column of values. @(x)sum(x.^2) on cell {1,2}=5; @(x)max-min range; empty cell gets fillval -1. vs MATLAB R2025b.
